title: Profile of People who Downloaded TraceTogether App
what_it_is: Profile of People who Downloaded TraceTogether App

sections.label: TraceTogether voluntary use and wearable device
sections.summary: TraceTogether has 1.5 million voluntary downloads but works less well on iOS, so it is not mandated and a portable wearable device is being developed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Today, TraceTogether has been downloaded on a voluntary basis by 1.5 million users.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, the app does not appear to work as well on iOS or Apple devices as the iOS operating system suspends Bluetooth scanning when the app is running in the background.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Because TraceTogether does not work equally well across all smart phones, we have decided, therefore, at this point in time, not to mandate the compulsory use of TraceTogether.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Instead, we are developing and will soon roll out a portable wearable device that will achieve the same objective as TraceTogether, but will not depend on possession of a smart phone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: If this portable device works, we may then distribute it to everyone in Singapore.

sections.label: TraceTogether app upgrade and download data
sections.summary: The app was upgraded to register NRIC or FIN in addition to mobile number, and no breakdown of downloads by gender or age is available.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: We thank those who have voluntarily downloaded the app to date and we urge more to download the app.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: We have also just upgraded the app to register the NRIC or FIN of the user, in addition to the user's mobile number, so that we can more quickly establish the link between the identity of the confirmed cases and their close contacts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: To Mr Gan Thiam Poh's question, we do not, at this point in time, have the breakdown of the downloads by gender or age, because such data is not currently collected by the app.

sections.label: Deletion of data older than 25 days
sections.summary: Data older than 25 days will be automatically deleted from your phone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The data that is older than 25 days will be automatically deleted from your phone.
